checks: Policy obtains rows from Pending.view and returns selected.token unchanged; no fabricated owner, UID, screen token, index or choice.
Only public current deck/relic inventory, public definitions, potion capacity/count, visible card offers and deterministic scoreCard are consulted. No future RNG peeking or state writes.

Full potion slots or a visible blocksPotions relic make potion claim ineligible: shopRelicRewards exposes choice=0 skip, selected legally; pendingBossRelic exposes done which legally discards unresolved potion once other visible rewards have been processed.

Driver prioritizes mandatory modal resolution before combat, rewards, act transition or room navigation. It uses Pending.resolve, the same transactional public resolver as UI, and does not clear pending owners directly.
Loop continues for a remaining pending owner even if phase is terminal. This resolves public modal obligations rather than forcing victory/defeat or moving the floor.

Controlled regression source verifies actual generated bottled relic, rejects navigation while owner pending, resolves legal bottle UID, keeps original floor/node/phase, rejects stale token with deep state equality, then navigates from the same completed chest.

Regression sources also cover mirror, Empty Cage, Tiny House, Orrery, Cauldron, card reward selection, full potion slots and Sozu. Controlled Run.obtainRelic/map changes are confined to test preconditions, absent from production campaign driver, and are not natural acquisition evidence.
